Senior Backend Engineer

Acme Robotics is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Toronto team. You will design and operate services that move real-time telemetry from thousands of robots into our analytics platform.

This is a full-time position. We expect strong Python and PostgreSQL skills, experience running production Kubernetes workloads, and a pragmatic attitude toward on-call.

We offer competitive compensation, stock options, and a learning budget for every engineer.

Acme Robotics is an equal opportunity employer.
